ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; visible surface area is over 90% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with sharp high-intensity pixel transitions at the distal tips and along water-spray boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the main fluke body. High-contrast white contiguous clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Isolated white speckles are visible on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45-50 degrees dividing the primary lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude of serrations is most pronounced on the right lobe with multiple irregular peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering sharply to points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (barnacle attachments) concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned white linear disruptions/scratches on the dark surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial barnacle colonization and trailing brown organic mass (seaweed or kelp) attached to the distal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, irregular brownish-red biological mass extending from the right fluke tip, distinct from the primary fluke pigmentation.
